title: Research: optimize ordered dirty echoes at fixed scratch (no new kappa)
head: d222e348179cc02a54d6d26dbd2838944f62c6e5
body:
An exact interval optimizer reduces the complete dirty-echo leaf bill from **512 to 464 calls at 27 factors / six borrowed arrays**, and **2,112 to 1,600 at 56 factors / eight borrowed arrays**, compared with PR689's improved balanced ternary schedule. Every inverse and restoration call is included, and factor order is preserved.

**Status: recursive-interface research / finite construction refinement. No new κ.**

The optimizer admits unbalanced contiguous splits, mixed binary/ternary nodes and positive integer leaf prices at fixed common precision. It proves and implements the minimum over that precise tree class and PR673's reserved-connector allocation discipline. The 27-factor root splits into 9,7,11; this is outside PR689's balanced class. The package also retains the 15-factor / 160-call result as predecessor work.

Only `research/ordered-dirty-echo/` is added. It contains the written identity and complete cost/precision recurrence, a small optimizer and streaming word emitter, frozen exact witnesses, source pins, an independent verifier, and a local validation receipt. `upstream/` and the selected frontier are unchanged.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/ordered-dirty-echo/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_ORDERED_DIRTY_ECHO: 642 exhaustive cases; 207 ordered trees; 64 pinned predecessor words; 4 witnesses; 4 rejected mutations`.

Validation passed on macOS arm64 / Python 3.14.8:

- Independent exhaustive postfix-tree enumeration for all `{1,3}` price vectors through six factors and every scratch budget from zero through `n-1`; separate path-based price/scratch accounting.
- Exact noncommutative symbolic products and dirty restoration for every enumerated tree and both signs; four larger witnesses; nonlinear integer restoration and a dirt-dependent-output counterexample.
- Exact complete-word comparison against the unchanged pinned PR673 generator; rejected omitted restore, reversed factor order, undercharged middle child and insufficient scratch.
- Complete certificate replay under ordinary and isolated optimized Python, standalone package relocation, certificate integer/boolean corruption rejection, source-drift rejection, selected-record binding and staged whitespace checks.

The optimum is local to the stated tree/allocation class. The uniform factor counts are interface fixtures, not claimed PR628 prime-power inversion instances; unequal prices are abstract scheduling inputs, not measured supplier costs. No lifetime-aware ancestor reuse, higher-fanout optimum, source-access realization or practical speedup is claimed. The inherited direct all-role adapter still has optimistic moment at least `6-6/n >= 3`, so this scheduling change does not establish a new multiplication exponent. Analytic, compiler, physical layout, precision, tape and supplier obligations remain inherited. The full repository suite, selected cold replay, remote CI, Lean and PR628 numerical leaf replay were not run.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. OS assignment seed **56**, recursive-interfaces track. No pinned coordination issue existed, so the claim is local. Three candidate tasks, scope, stopping rule and overlap evidence are recorded in `CLAIM.md`.

The final overlap refresh covered **547 open PRs through #728**. Concurrent [PR714](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/714), head `efad8a40094ab453c0525efef0b0eff2a5d8b850`, optimizes a root split with **one clean checkpoint** and balanced binary dirty children. This contribution keeps **every borrowed array arbitrary/dirty** and changes the entire ordered binary/ternary tree. No PR714 code or result is imported; its different storage contract is credited explicitly.

Credit: androolloyd's PR673 (`bfff94e78f0e75ebd2593e3cc7710ae5290e8be3`) supplies the echo identity and source; Dillon Amburgey's PR689 (`0dedef12f05f9a06faf9d4e1c8b1462c0e3bff3a`) supplies the corrected balanced comparison; Chafik Boukhalfa's PR628 supplies the inherited leaf contract; 0xkilgore's PR663 supplies the prior independent binary audit. PR673 advanced to `156f259b99723468cfdd2b5d47d0ba894f09bea7` during this run with separate sharing-cost work; all three consumed source files remain byte-identical. Exact blob/SHA-256 pins are in `SOURCES.json`.

Prepared for **Sagar Thakrar (@thakrarsagar)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate proof, independent-checking and adversarial-review workers. Apache-2.0; no independent human review or full formal theorem claim.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
